chunks: And those of the Right Hand — how (happy) are those of the Right Hand

key_terms.أَصْحَابُ الْيَمِينِ: People of the Right Hand, a class of successful believers

ai.seo_question: Who are the People of the Right Hand in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often contrasted with the 'People of the Left Hand' to illustrate the dichotomy between those who attain salvation through righteous deeds and faith, and those who face ruin. The 'right hand' symbolizes honor and divine favor, reflecting the belief that the righteous will receive their scrolls with joy, a concept deeply tied to the concept of *Barzakh* and the final reckoning.
